explanation: The text characterizes PALLAS as strictly 'node-positive' early-stage disease, but the evidence describes eligibility as early-stage HR+/HER2- patients post-local treatment without specifying node-positive status as a defining criterion.
suggested_rewrite: Describe PALLAS as an adjuvant trial in early-stage HR+/HER2- breast cancer patients (not limited to node-positive) rather than specifying 'node-positive' as a defining eligibility feature.
